description: This source file contains unit test cases for the WorkActivityStore class, validating its behavior with handling jobs and tools, icon state transitions, and label extraction logic within a macOS app context.

classes.name: WorkActivityStoreTests
classes.description: A test suite for the WorkActivityStore class, containing multiple test functions to verify behavior under different scenarios.

methods.name: `main session job preempts other`
methods.description: Test that starting a new job with session 'main' preempts other ongoing jobs and updates icon state accordingly.

methods.name: `job stays working after tool result grace`
methods.description: Verify that the job remains in a working state after tool command completion and related conditions.

methods.name: `tool label extracts first line and shortens home`
methods.description: Check label extraction logic from tool commands, including handling of multi-line commands and home directory shortening.

methods.name: `resolve icon state honors override selection`
methods.description: Test that icon state overrides are honored correctly when explicitly set.
